fields.Name: T27 - Data Explorer Browse Courses
fields.Description: Verifies that the Courses entity opens from the Data Explorer entity tree and displays a populated grid of course records.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) and go to Data Explorer, then its Data section. In the left-hand entity tree locate the 'Courses' entity and click it. Wait patiently if the grid is slow to load (pages can take 10-30s in this resource-constrained environment). Success is reached when a grid of multiple course records is displayed, including course codes such as CHZ-101.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Courses' entity is selected in the Data Explorer Data section
A row grid of multiple course records is displayed
At least one course code in the CHZ-### or SAF-### format (e.g. CHZ-101) is visible
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
